answer: The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in bridge, expire in island, and lotus lists each expiry. Someone running 10 aliases hence needs 164 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 703 identities would post 2308 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
